name: Shaewoo Product Videos
author: gosu1210

sections.description:
Shaewoo makes a short product video from a listing you have already written. No editing, no timeline, no design skills. You press Make video on a product and a vertical MP4 comes back a minute or two later, built from that product’s own photographs, title, price and description.

Every render also returns a full-size still: one frame with no caption and no progress bar, which you can use as a listing image straight away. On a paid plan the video and the still have no watermark. On a free account both carry a Shaewoo watermark.

What you get

  • A vertical video sized for Reels, TikTok and Shorts, or square, portrait or landscape if you prefer.
  • A listing image from the same render, at no extra cost.
  • Your own copyright line drawn on the closing frame, so the video carries your name wherever it is reposted.
  • Six looks, from pure black and heavy type to light and editorial.
  • One product at a time, or a whole page of them with the bulk action.
  • Optionally, a video made automatically whenever you publish a new product. This is off until you turn it on.

What it needs

  • WooCommerce 8.0 or later.
  • A Shaewoo account and its connection key, from https://shaewoo.com/dashboard/settings.
  • Your site served over https, and product images reachable from the public internet — the finished video is delivered back to your site by callback.

External service

This plugin sends product data to Shaewoo (https://shaewoo.com), a service operated by DontMisimi Corp, in order to render videos. Nothing is sent until you ask for a video: either by pressing Make video on a product, using the bulk action, or turning on Automatic in the settings, after which a video is requested each time you publish a product.

What is sent, per product, each time a video is requested: the product title, description, price, sale price, your store name, its first category, its tags, its currency, and the URLs of up to six of its images. Your site’s callback address and a token generated by this plugin are sent so the finished file can be returned.

What is never sent: customer data, order data, and anything about your other products.

  • Service: https://shaewoo.com
  • Terms of service: https://shaewoo.com/legal/terms
  • Privacy policy: https://shaewoo.com/legal/privacy

A free Shaewoo account can make videos and stills with a watermark. Paid plans remove the watermark and raise the monthly allowance. See https://shaewoo.com/pricing.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Go to WooCommerce → Shaewoo Videos and paste your connection key (find it at https://shaewoo.com/dashboard/settings).
  3. Choose a look and a shape, and set your copyright line if you want one other than your store name.
  4. Open any product and press Make the video, or select several on the products list and use the Make Shaewoo videos bulk action.
sections.faq:
Do I need to know anything technical?

No. If you can publish a product, you can make a video of it.

Where does the video appear?

On the product page, below the description, unless you turn that off. You can also place it yourself anywhere with the [shaewoo_video] shortcode, or [shaewoo_video id="123"] for a specific product.

Can I download the files?

Yes. The panel on the product edit screen has a download link for both the video and the listing image.

Why does a product say “Failed”?

Hover the word in the Video column, or open the product, and the reason is shown. The two common ones are an API key that is not valid and a site that is not served over https — Shaewoo delivers finished videos back to your site, and it will not post them over an unencrypted connection.

Some of my photographs were skipped. Why?

The renderer fetches your images from their public URLs. If your site is behind a login, on a staging domain, or on localhost, it cannot reach them, and the plugin tells you how many were missed rather than pretending the video used all of them.

Does making a video again cost another one?

Yes. Every render counts against your monthly allowance, including a repeat of a product you have already done.

Does it work with variable products?

Yes. The price shown is the one WooCommerce shows on the shop page, which for a variable product is the lowest variation price.
sections.changelog:
1.2.1

  • Tested with WordPress 7.2. Removes an unused Domain Path header flagged by Plugin Check.

1.2.0

  • Automatic videos are now off until you turn them on, so the plugin never contacts Shaewoo on its own.
  • Updates now come from WordPress.org; the self-hosted update check is removed.
  • Declares WooCommerce as a required plugin. The “needs WooCommerce” notice now only shows on the Plugins screen.
  • Fixed the links to the terms, privacy policy and connection key page.
  • Tested with WordPress 7.1 and WooCommerce 11.3.

1.1.0

  • New installs make a video for each newly published product by default. Switch it off under Settings, Shaewoo, Automatic. Existing settings are not changed.

1.0.0

  • First release.
